reportTitle: Phase 7A.2 DictionaryManager & Atomic Hot Switching Verification Evidence

managerContract.ownership: Exclusive handle ownership transferred to DictionaryManager upon constructor/distinct candidate activation; reusing active handle rejected without close

activation.retirementFailureBehavior: non-rollback; new candidate remains active, generation advances, error recorded and observable in snapshot

noActiveGap.stateTransitionProof: atomic single-threaded JavaScript assignment with no intermediate unassigned or null active slot

tests.initialLookup: PASS (lookup delegates to initial dictionary exactly once)
tests.successfulSwap: PASS (A active -> activate B -> B active, generation 2, A.close called once, B remains open)
tests.repeatedSwap: PASS (A -> B -> C sequential activations with exact single retirement per candidate)
tests.failedPreparation: PASS (external candidate open failure leaves active manager reference and generation untouched)
tests.invalidModeSource: PASS (rejected mode/source mismatch closes rejected candidate and preserves active reference)
tests.activationAfterClose: PASS (rejected with DictionaryUnavailableError and closes candidate immediately)
tests.idempotentClose: PASS (manager.close() idempotent, closes active dictionary exactly once)
tests.retirementCloseFailure: PASS (old close throw preserves committed new candidate, advances generation, records error, no rollback)
tests.stableHandlerSwitch: PASS (createLookupHandler called once; serves sqlite-fixture before swap and ecdict-local after swap)
tests.handlerAfterManagerClose: PASS (lookup through handler after manager close returns controlled 500 dictionary-unavailable)
tests.activeHandleAliasingValid: PASS (same handle + valid descriptor rejected with TypeError, handle remains open, generation unchanged, active lookup succeeds)
tests.activeHandleAliasingInvalidMode: PASS (same handle + invalid mode/source rejected before validation cleanup, handle not closed, manager remains ready)
tests.activeHandleAliasingEmptyIdentity: PASS (same handle + empty/blank identity rejected before validation cleanup, handle not closed, manager remains ready)
tests.snapshotContract: PASS (snapshot carries activeMode, ambiguous mode alias removed at runtime and compile-time)
